title: No Armor Render
description: A mod that allows you to hide absolutely everything you can put on yourself, including mods
body:
This modification allows you to visually hide the wearable armor. All protection and effects remain functional.

Full support for all modifications.

The "3D Skin Layers" function is working.​​

Customize it for yourself. In the settings, you can turn on/off: 
- helmet
- armor
- elites
- greaves
- boots
- armor display for other players
- armor display on hands from the first person​​​​​

By default, the settings button is H
